description: An agent builds a task and a command checks it. A failed check goes back to an agent with the log, up to 3 tries. Then Opus tries to rescue it.

inputs.name: task
inputs.label: Task
inputs.description: What to build or fix, in plain words.

inputs.name: check
inputs.label: Check
inputs.description: The shell command that proves the work, for example the tests.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: What the agent reports it did.

outputs.name: rescue
outputs.description: What the rescue did. Empty when the work needed no rescue.

nodes.label: Implement
Check
nodes.command:
# The input `check` arrives as an environment variable: run it as a shell command.
sh -c "{{check}}" || exit 1
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
	echo 'Commit your changes. Not committed:'
	git status --short
	exit 1
fi

nodes.label: Rescue
Check the rescue
nodes.command:
sh -c "{{check}}" || exit 1
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
	echo 'Commit your changes. Not committed:'
	git status --short
	exit 1
fi
